They are reconciled explicitly here, never silently aliased; source samples are served verbatim as historical evidence.

scope_statement: Owner-adopted runtime-wide historical Torch-reference TIMING reuse for the patched-Triton transition, extended by the 2026-10-06 human ruling ("卡之间是等价的为什么不能跨卡复用呢") to CROSS-CARD reuse: a sealed reference (8-sample profiler median, audited on one card) may serve an evaluation on ANY fleet card, because the equivalence premise is verified per evaluation by the existing fresh eight-sample sentinel measured on the CURRENT card and compared with the served entry; drift beyond the unchanged +/-3% keeps the existing per-current-card monotone remeasurement (F-63). Evidence basis: the v3 sampled grade8 comparison (EID ev_e04caf2e5693456c8823ee6229543655, 2026-10-05) on official_l3_BatchMatmul cases 1,6,11,18,33,43, the 2026-10-06 live 51-case card-8 timing_reuse run (EID ev_8cc6293b565048a1a6ab47289e623017), and the verified uniqueness of all 1046 sealed workload identities across cards (cards 1-8: 150/131/175/110/100/124/107/149). This policy is NOT a remeasurement, coverage proof, or individual validation of all 1046 source cases on every card; the sentinel is the per-evaluation validation. Timing evidence only: correctness, quality and admission gates are unchanged. 2026-10-06 optional-accelerator ruling ("如果有reference更好若果没有也能跑") carried by branch af31c25: when this policy serves no validated hit the engine takes the production e4a36f7 reference path for its configuration (original single measurement with no cache configured or a non-official task; e4a36f7's own eight-sample remeasure on a cache-configured miss or drift), so this policy can only ever accelerate, never alter, the service.
